tool_calls.goal: Find the most recent authoritative official Tokyo Metropolitan Government population figure available as of 2026-09-03, treating Tokyo strictly as Tokyo Metropolis (not city proper or metro area). Prioritize an official TMG page or publication, reconcile source/publication/reference-date differences, and return the exact integer population plus the reference date, publication date if shown, official source title, and URL. Research only; do not use ungrounded prior knowledge.

context_at_bad_turn.text:
**Most recent authoritative Tokyo Metropolis figure available as of 2026-09-03:** **14,303,513 people**, an official **estimated population** at **2026-08-01**. It was published by the Tokyo Metropolitan Government (TMG) General Affairs Bureau on **2026-08-31** in **「『東京都の人口（推計）』の概要（令和8年8月1日現在）」** (*Overview of “Population of Tokyo (Estimate)” [as of 1 August 2026]*). [1]

URL: https://www.metro.tokyo.lg.jp/information/press/2026/08/2026083104

**Reconciliation / scope:** This is Tokyo **Metropolis**, not Tokyo city proper or the wider metro area: TMG explicitly identifies the figure as the Tokyo-to total and breaks it into the 23 wards (9,997,234), cities (4,231,953), counties (52,685), and islands (21,641), which sum to 14,303,513. [1] The TMG monthly-estimate index independently marks the August 1 observation as the latest posted 2026 release and leaves September onward unposted; therefore the August 1 reference-date figure, published August 31, is the latest available by September 3. [2]

**Interpretation:** It is a monthly TMG estimate, based on the 2025-10-01 census preliminary population plus monthly Basic Resident Register changes, and includes Japanese and foreign residents. The PDF/table itself does not show a separate publication date; the dated official press-release page supplies the August 31 publication date. [1][3]

Sources:
[1] https://www.metro.tokyo.lg.jp/information/press/2026/08/2026083104
[2] https://www.toukei.metro.tokyo.lg.jp/jsuikei/js-index.htm
[3] https://www.toukei.metro.tokyo.lg.jp/jsuikei/2026/js268f0100.pdf
